items.title: David Weinstein Interview, 1988-09-22
items.q: And he played a few jobs with us, with the dance band part of the Donbusters.

ctx.x: Do you know his middle name by any chance? No, I don't.

Something we could look up somehow. I might be able to find him in the dead files downstairs. Dead in the sense that we don't use him anymore. I don't know how he got the nickname, but that was a distinguishing from Santo to Trombone player. Sure, yeah. And when did you meet him? Oh somewhere, I would say about midway in my career, because he was Santo's younger. And he played a few jobs with us, with the dance band part of the Donbusters. We were playing night jobs, parties of clubs and things like that. And the…
Pec. Yeah. And did you know Frank Mutz, piano player? The name doesn't ring any bells, no. When did you join the union?
